prompt:
Use the year-ordered table in the image. It shows a spreadsheet-style table with one Name column, several year columns in chronological order, full grid lines, and a shaded header row. Read the named row over time and report the requested integer result. Determine the absolute difference between the 2019 and 2021 values for Aimo.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence field: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] ordered as [start-year cell, end-year cell].
Answer field: set "answer" to the exact integer temporal result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":4}
